description: A real Singapore Airlines boarding pass (MNL to SIN) returned no originAirport/destinationAirport, even though both codes are clearly printed. This ticket mixes the two layouts fixed in 0.9.0 and 0.10.0 on the same document: "MNL" sits alone on its own line with no time attached (the layout 0.10.0's bare-code-line pattern was added for), but "SIN 20:50" has its time on the same line as its code (the layout 0.9.0's code-near-time pattern was added for). Each pattern ran as its own complete pass over the whole document and only ever found its one matching code -- the code-near-time pass found only SIN, the bare-code-line pass found only MNL -- so neither pass's "exactly two distinct codes" threshold was ever met, even though the two codes together were sitting right there. Fixed by checking both patterns per line and merging into one combined candidate list, still bounded by the same "exactly two distinct codes, or don't guess" rule.
